subject: Observability adoption cadence with Bluefield AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability adoption cadence & initial ask (Bluefield)

Team — quick summary from this morning's pre-kick call with Bluefield (Matthew + Sara): they want a pragmatic onboarding that prioritizes production signal visibility first (dashboards + alert routing) and then tracing hooks and runbook handover. Key asks:

- A one-page "adoption cadence" that lays out milestones for the first 6 weeks (dashboards, alert mapping, trace instrumentation, runbooks, handover).
- A minimal dashboard bundle for their SRE team (error rates, tail latency by model, prefix cache hit rate).
- Clear alert routing matrix (who gets what severity, Slack vs PagerDuty).

I attached an initial cadence draft (onboarding_adoption_cadence_v1.pdf) — very rough.

Next steps I suggested:
1) Monica to own customer-facing milestones and scheduling.
2) Laura to propose dashboard templates and sample panels.
3) Soojin to draft a starter runbook and alert taxonomy doc.

Can everyone confirm availability for a 30-min working session this Thursday 10–10:30 PT? Also copied the Bluefield contacts in the separate thread once we have times.

— Ben
[Attachment: onboarding_adoption_cadence_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Roe <matt.roe@bluefield.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability adoption cadence & initial ask (Bluefield)

Thanks Ben — I skimmed the draft and this looks like a sensible play. I'm looping Matthew directly so we can lock a working session and confirm stakeholders. Matthew / Sara — would Thursday 10–10:30 PT work for you for a focused working session to align on the 6-week milestones? We will bring: dashboard template samples, an initial alert routing matrix, and a starter runbook draft.

Quick clarifications for Bluefield so we scope properly:
- Are you planning to send production traffic to Redwood-instrumented endpoints right away or start with a shadow traffic phase? That changes the tracing rollout cadence.
- Any compliance constraints we should be aware of for logs/trace retention?

I'll upload the cadence PDF and an invite once we confirm time.

— Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Signature: Monica Patel | monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123]

From: Matthew Roe <matt.roe@bluefield.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara.klein@bluefield.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability adoption cadence & initial ask (Bluefield)

Monica — Thursday 10 PT works for us. To answer your questions:

- We'll start with a shadow phase for the first two weeks, then flip a subset of traffic at week 3 if all looks good.
- Retention: 90 days for logs and traces; anything beyond that needs a business case.

Sara (SRE) will be on the call and will own instrumentation questions. We're primarily concerned about alert noise during the shadow phase — we want to avoid paging unless it's a production-severity issue.

Looking forward — will join Thursday.

— Matthew

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Matthew Roe <matt.roe@bluefield.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Dashboard templates and sample panels

Following up from today's working session — I attached a spreadsheet with three starter dashboard templates and a short notes tab mapping metrics to user stories (SRE, Product, CS). Highlights:

- Landing dashboard: error rate (5m/1h), request volume by route, P50/P95/P99 latency, model token throughput.
- Model health: KV cache hit %, sequence length distribution, per-model throughput, top error classes.
- Triage view: recent errors with stack traces, slowest prefixes, suspect model weights (when available).

I also sketched an initial alert routing matrix: Sev-1 (on-call), Sev-2 (on-call + CS on Slack #bluefield-ops), Sev-3 (CS async). We'll refine after an initial two-week shadow.

Attaching: redwood_dashboard_templates.xlsx

— Laura
[Attachment: redwood_dashboard_templates.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Roe <matt.roe@bluefield.ai>, Sara Klein <sara.klein@bluefield.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability adoption cadence & initial ask (Bluefield)

Great progress this week — thank you everyone for the quick turnaround. Agreed deliverables and next actions:

- Week 0–1 (shadow prep): Redwood provides dashboard templates and alert taxonomy (Laura). Bluefield provides sample traffic profile and any retention constraints (Matthew/Sara).
- Week 2 (shadow): Soojin to ship starter runbook and failure triage steps. CS will monitor slack channel for noise and adjust thresholds.
- Week 3 (partial flip): If shadow looks stable after two weeks, proceed with partial traffic flip. Redwood engineering to be on-call for the first 48 hours.
- Documentation handover: consolidated runbook, dashboard links, and the final cadence doc will be uploaded to the shared Drive folder. I will open the Jira ticket INF-4821 to track tasks and put a DocuSign SLA draft for review.

Links: Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBluefield-Onboarding), Jira (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821), DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/bluefield-sla-draft)

If there are no objections I'll mark the cadence doc as "v1" and move the tasks into INF-4821. Thanks — I'll take point on weekly check-ins through week 6.

— Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
